title: promote-release.mjs --rollback: every recorded prior latest must be semver-less than the release
description: Paired with lore-cli LCLI-617, 2026-09-27, and landed together AFTER the 0.11.0 pair ships so the two verdicts stay identical. Not a 0.11.0 blocker: it needs a hand-edited record plus an operator running --rollback. The hole left after QCLI-390: a record whose priorLatest is NEWER than its version, e.g. "5.7.0" in a 5.6.7 record. It passes strict X.Y.Z and != record.version, and it passes checkRollbackState while latest still reads 5.6.7. So an ungated --rollback moves latest onto a version no receipt qualified. Rule, agreed with lore-cli: every priorLatest must compare semver-less than record.version. Promotion never moves latest backwards, so a legitimate record always satisfies it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: validateRecord refuses a priorLatest that is equal to or semver-greater than record.version, comparing major, minor and patch numerically so that 0.10.0 is greater than 0.9.0
Tests cover greater, equal, lesser and a numeric-not-lexical case, and a mutation control shows they fail without the rule
Lands in the same window as lore-cli LCLI-617, citing its SHA, and the two rules are confirmed identical
